svg.title: Support-count ablation: detailed simulation and real-world results
svg.desc: Paper-style grouped table. Simulation has Mass Collision, Mass Balance, and Light Switch with all reported K=1,2,4,8 configurations. Real-world has Door, Stick Balance, and Soft Body with all reported K=1,2,4 configurations. Ball is excluded pending further analysis. Metrics are PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, object mean and final error, task-specific physical error, and action success.

g.text: All recorded support settings for three simulation and three real-world tasks; Ball remains under study.
K4 + four distant actions; all-action video
Metrics: PSNR and SSIM higher is better; LPIPS and all object/physical errors lower are better. Videos = evaluated query clips.
Collision physical = travel-distance error (px) / final-displacement error (px) / terminal-speed error (px/s). K=1 uses observed support; K=2/4/8 use predicted actions.
Balance physical = bar-tilt MAE (deg) / final tilt error (deg) / angular-velocity MAE (deg/s). K=8 video metrics use the full 15-action set; K=1/2/4 use disjoint query subsets.
Light physical = switch-transition time error (frames); query-video count and action denominator were not reported in the source summary. Real-world physical-error column is unreported.
Collision K=8 and Door K=4 sums support losses, unlike their mean-loss counterparts. Door action requires the exact first-close level; adjacent levels receive zero. N = 9 environments.
Stick action precision on seeded36: K=2 5/6; K=4 4/4. Cross-task object values have different meanings/units and should not be ranked against one another.
